weakness.title: Missing Logging of Access to Sensitive Area
weakness.description: Access to a sensitive area is not recorded, so entries and exits cannot be attributed to a person.

extended_description.applicability: Areas that hold sensitive information, equipment, media or processes, such as server rooms, archives, laboratories, prototype areas and storage rooms. Applies to every route into the area, including doors, hatches, shared corridors and passages used by staff, visitors and contractors.
extended_description.exploitation: A person enters a sensitive area and leaves without any record, so the access is neither noticed nor attributable.

row.details: Entries to the area cannot be attributed to an individual.
Unauthorized or unusual access to the area cannot be detected from records.
Information and assets in the area can be accessed without leaving a trace.

row.description: List sensitive areas and every route into them, and require a record for each.
Capture the identity, place, time and direction of each entry and exit, including denied attempts.
Keep a signed register where no automated record is possible, such as for keyed doors, and reconcile it with other records.
Entry records identify individuals and must be limited to what is needed, protected and retained in accordance with applicable law.

row.reference: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PE-3 Physical Access Control
